market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window. RBA decision looms with hawkish bias; iron ore and oil weakness drag materials and energy. Consumer stress limits upside. Expect range-bound to modestly lower ^AXJO with volatility spikes around RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds, structural super/pension reform, and renewable policy uncertainty create headwinds. Gold, financials, and gas offer relative strength. A rate cut cycle in late 2026/early 2027 could re-rate growth equities if recession fears peak.
